paraphrase: Two schema controls: the raw message-only and Catholic mandate-scope conditionals coexist while their combined actual-mandate/founded-visible-body antecedent is unrealized; with an actual joint witness, the raw message-only thesis excludes the exact scope. The first coarse target does not identify which antecedent is absent. EMPTY-MANDATE-CATHOLIC-SCOPE-COEXISTENCE separately exports the stronger absence-of-every-mandate control with actual founding and visibility.
